<description>
Follow-up to #36791, https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36791#discussion_r4565761925 by @ryanofsky.

#36791 fixed the `waitTipChanged` timeout on slow hosts, but the `template6` `waitNext` call has the same race: it waits for an event the test triggers after a 0.1s sleep, with a 1s timeout.

This adds `long_ipc_timeout` and uses it for all waits that end on an event the test triggers.

To reproduce failure on master:

```diff
diff --git a/test/functional/interface_ipc_mining.py b/test/functional/interface_ipc_mining.py
index cdef196fd0..49e1c8a9c1 100755
--- a/test/functional/interface_ipc_mining.py
+++ b/test/functional/interface_ipc_mining.py
@@ -320,7 +320,8 @@ class IPCMiningTest(BitcoinTestFramework):
                 self.log.debug("Wait for another, get one after increase in fees in the mempool")
                 template6 = await wait_and_do(
                     mining_wait_next_template(template5, stack, ctx, waitoptions),
-                    lambda: self.miniwallet.send_self_transfer(fee_rate=10, from_node=self.nodes[0]))
+                    lambda: self.miniwallet.send_self_transfer(fee_rate=10, from_node=self.nodes[0]),
+                    sleep_time=1.2)
                 assert template6 is not None
                 block4 = await mining_get_block(template6, ctx)
                 assert_equal(len(block4.vtx), 3)

```
</description>

Tested ACK 74135e2e625030b18daf7539bd19dabb75948af1. This finishes the fix from #36791: every wait that returns on an event the test triggers now has at least a minute, so none of them can time out on a slow host with the default timeout factor. I checked that the test passes normally, with the faketime command from #36791, and with `sleep_time=1.2` on the `template6` wait, which failed before.

The waits still using `default_ipc_timeout` (`template4`, `template5` and the two `waitNext` policy tests) are fine as they are: the fees they wait for are already in the mempool, and `waitNext` always checks fees once after its first one-second tick, however short the timeout.
